fullDescription: A neo-brutalist form-builder landing page: thick 3px ink borders and hard offset shadows on warm paper with one electric acid-yellow accent, anchored by a live-preview profile form showing every field state.
prompt:
## Resumo
A neo-brutalist 'FORMCAST' landing page built around THE form: an acid-yellow on warm-paper system (paper #f4f1ea page, acid #e8ff00 accent, near-black ink #0a0a0a) where everything is bounded by 3px ink borders and hard offset drop-shadows. The hero is a two-column split: a left pitch (eyebrow pill, a huge Archivo-900 headline with an acid highlight on 'DON'T MUMBLE.', sub-paragraph, two chunky CTAs, and a row of checkbox trust items) beside the right 'live preview' form card, a thick-bordered profile form showing the full range of field states (a plain text field with helper, a valid email field with an acid check chip, a 3-way segmented Plan control, a prefix workspace-slug field in an error state, an acid checkbox, and a chunky acid Submit). Below: a scrolling ink marquee ticker, a 6-card patterns grid, an acid library strip of category cards, a 3-step 'how it works' bordered band, a 2-card pricing block (free paper card + dark ink 'most cast' card), an acid CTA band, and a footer with a newsletter capture. Brutalist by default, themeable via a single accent variable; reflows to one column on mobile.

## Estilo Visual
Design in a neo-brutalist style. Palette: paper #f4f1ea (page background and lightest cards), ink #0a0a0a (all text, all borders, the one dark surface), acid #e8ff00 (the single electric-yellow accent: highlights, CTAs, icon tiles, active segments, checkboxes, valid-state chips); plain white #ffffff for input field interiors. Every box has a 3px solid ink border (`border-[3px] border-ink`) and a hard, NON-blurred offset shadow: shadow-hardsm = 4px 4px 0 0 #0a0a0a, shadow-hard = 6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a, shadow-hardlg = 10px 10px 0 0 #0a0a0a. No border-radius anywhere (sharp 90-degree corners), no gradients, no blur. Selection highlight is acid bg on ink text. A subtle background grid (.grid-bg): two 1px linear-gradients at rgba(10,10,10,0.07), 44px tiles, placed behind the hero, library and pricing sections. Typography is a three-font system from Google Fonts: Archivo (400-900) as the display/heading/label font (use font-900 for big headlines and prices, font-800 for labels), Space Grotesk (400-700) as the body font, Space Mono (400,700) for eyebrows, meta, ticker text and monospace prefixes; uppercase + wide tracking on all eyebrows/labels/buttons. Physical micro-interactions: .btn-press and .field-focus translate(-2px,-2px) with an 8px hard shadow on hover, and translate(3px,3px) with a 1px shadow on :active; .lift cards translate(-2px,-2px) to a 10px shadow on hover. Loud, blunt, maximal-contrast, furniture-solid, never soft.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (z-50) on paper with a 3px ink bottom border, 64px tall, inside a max-w-6xl row justify-between. Left = brand: a 36px square acid icon tile (3px ink border, shadow-hardsm) holding a ph:square-half-bold icon, then the 'FORMCAST' wordmark in Archivo font-900 tracking-tight. Center (md+ only) = four nav links (Builder, Patterns, Library, Pricing) in Archivo 13px font-700 uppercase tracking-wide, each with a hover:bg-acid swatch. Right = a 'Log in' text link (sm+) and a 'Start free' button: an ink-filled rectangle, 3px ink border, paper text, shadow-hardsm, btn-press, with a ph:arrow-right-bold icon.

### Hero (pitch + live form)
A grid-bg section with a 3px ink bottom border, max-w-6xl, generous vertical padding, grid items-start lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_0.95fr] gap-12. LEFT pitch column: an inline eyebrow pill (3px ink border, acid fill, Space Mono 12px font-700 uppercase, shadow-hardsm) with a ph:lightning-fill icon reading 'Prompt -> shippable form'; a huge headline in Archivo font-900 leading-[0.94] tracking-tight (44px up to 68px) reading 'FORMS THAT' then 'DON'T MUMBLE.' where the second line is wrapped in an acid box-decoration-clone highlight; a 17px ink/80 Space Grotesk sub-paragraph (max-w-md); a CTA row with a primary acid 'Cast a form' button (3px border, shadow-hard, btn-press, ph:magic-wand-bold) and a secondary paper 'See patterns' button; and a wrap row of three Space Mono 12px uppercase trust items each prefixed by a ph:check-square-bold icon (Copy-paste React, A11y baked in, 600+ patterns). RIGHT column = the live-preview form card (see component).

### Live-preview form card (the hero component)
A relative container with an absolute rotated ink tag (-right-3 -top-3, rotate-3, ink fill, acid Space Mono text, 3px border, shadow-hardsm) reading 'live preview'. The card itself: paper, 3px ink border, shadow-hardlg, padding 6-8. Card header: a 3px ink bottom border row justify-between with 'New profile' (Archivo font-800 uppercase) and a 'draft' status (a small acid square chip + Space Mono label). Then a form with space-y-7 holding, in order: (1) a 'Username' field, a plain white text input in a 3px ink box with shadow-hard, value 'ekmas', plus a 14px ink/70 helper 'This is your public display name.'; (2) an 'Email' field in a valid state, white input value 'hey@formcast.dev' with a trailing 32px acid check chip (2px ink border, a hand-drawn-square SVG check), helper 'We only ping you about your casts.'; (3) a 'Plan' segmented control, a 3-column grid in one 3px ink box where each segment has 3px ink dividers and the active 'Free' is acid-filled while 'Pro'/'Team' are white; (4) a 'Workspace slug' field in an error state: a flex box with a paper Space-Mono prefix 'formcast.dev/' separated by a 3px border, input value 'my space', and a bold ink error line with a warning-triangle SVG reading 'No spaces. Try my-space.' (the suggestion chip is acid); (5) a checkbox row: a 24px acid checkbox (3px border, shadow-hardsm, SVG check) beside a 14px ink/80 consent label; (6) a submit row: a chunky acid 'Submit' button (Archivo font-900 uppercase, 3px border, shadow-hard, btn-press) beside a plain underline-on-hover 'Reset' text button.

### Marquee ticker
A full-width overflow-hidden ink band with a 3px ink bottom border, py-3, holding an infinite horizontal scrolling track (.ticker-track, 28s linear loop, translateX 0 to -50%, duplicated for seamlessness) of acid Archivo font-800 uppercase tracking-widest phrases separated by paper/40 slashes: Thick borders / Hard shadows / Blunt labels / Zero ambiguity / Real validation / Ship today.

### Patterns grid
A section with a 3px ink bottom border, max-w-6xl. Header row: a Space Mono eyebrow '/ what it gives you' and an Archivo font-900 h2 'Built like furniture, not fog.' beside a right-aligned 15px ink/70 supporting paragraph. Below: a grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 of six .lift cards, each a 3px ink border box (five white, the sixth acid-filled) with shadow-hard, holding a 48px square icon tile (3px ink border, acid fill or paper on the acid card, shadow-hardsm, a ph:* bold icon), an Archivo font-800 h3, and a 15px ink/70 description. Card titles: Honest fields, Loud validation, Keyboard-true, Real code out, Yours to repaint, 600+ in the library.

### Library strip
A grid-bg section on an acid background with a 3px ink bottom border, max-w-6xl. Header row: a Space Mono eyebrow '/ from the library', an Archivo font-900 h2 'Steal a starting point.', and a 'Browse all 600+' button (paper fill, 3px border, shadow-hard, btn-press, ph:arrow-right-bold). Below: a grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5 of four .lift category cards, each a paper box (3px ink border, shadow-hard) with a ph:* bold icon, an Archivo font-800 title, and a Space Mono pattern-count meta line: Login & signup (84 patterns), Checkout (61 patterns), Multi-step wizard (47 patterns), Survey & feedback (52 patterns).

### How-it-works band
A section with a 3px ink bottom border, max-w-6xl. A Space Mono eyebrow '/ three moves' and an Archivo font-900 h2 'Prompt. Tweak. Ship.'. Below: a single 3px ink border box with shadow-hardlg, split md:grid-cols-3 with 3px ink dividers between cells; the middle cell is acid-filled. Each cell holds a giant Archivo font-900 step number (01/02/03 in ink/15 or ink/25), an Archivo font-800 h3 (Describe it / Push it around / Take the code), and a 15px description.

### Pricing
A grid-bg section with a 3px ink bottom border, max-w-6xl, centered header: a Space Mono eyebrow '/ no mystery math' and an Archivo font-900 h2 'Pick a tier. That's the whole page.'. Below: a max-w-4xl md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 of two .lift cards. Card 1 'Caster' = paper, 3px ink border, shadow-hard: tier label, an Archivo font-900 '$0' + Space Mono '/forever', a 3-item check list (ph:check-square-bold), and a paper 'Start free' button (shadow-hardsm). Card 2 'Studio' = the dark ink card, paper text, shadow-hardlg, with an absolute rotated acid 'most cast' tag: an acid tier label, an Archivo font-900 '$19' + '/month', a 4-item list with acid ph:check-square-fill icons, and a chunky acid 'Go Studio' button with an acid-colored hard shadow (6px 6px 0 0 #e8ff00).

### CTA band
A full-width acid section with a 3px ink bottom border, centered, max-w-6xl: an Archivo font-900 h2 (up to 5xl, leading-[0.98]) 'Your next form is one blunt sentence away.', a 16px ink/80 sub-paragraph in warm proactive voice ('Free to start. No card. Cast something ugly-good in the next two minutes, ping us if it fights back and we'll sort it together.'), and a single chunky ink-filled 'Cast your first form' button (paper text, 3px border, shadow-hard, btn-press, ph:arrow-right-bold).

### Footer
A paper footer (no top border on the footer itself; the section above carries the divider), max-w-6xl, py-12. A grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-10: column 1 = the brand (acid square tile + 'FORMCAST' wordmark) and a 14px ink/65 tagline 'Forms from a prompt. Brutalist by default, yours to repaint.'; columns 2-3 = 'Product' and 'Resources' link lists (Archivo font-800 uppercase headings, 14px ink/70 links); column 4 = 'Stay in the loop' with a newsletter capture (a 3px ink box, white email input + an acid 'Go' button separated by a 3px border, shadow-hardsm) and a row of three square social icon buttons (X, GitHub, Discord; paper, 3px border, shadow-hardsm, btn-press). A 3px ink top-border bottom row in Space Mono 12px uppercase: '© 2026 FORMCAST' and Privacy / Terms / Status links.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Brutalist input field with focus-lift
A white text input wrapped in a 3px ink border box with shadow-hard. The wrapper is .field-focus: on :focus-within it grows the hard shadow to 8px 8px 0 0 #0a0a0a and translates translate(-1px,-1px). The input itself is bg-transparent, px-4 py-3.5, Space Grotesk 16px, placeholder ink/40, outline-none. Below each field sits a 14px font-500 ink/70 helper line. Sharp corners, no radius.

### Valid field with acid check chip
An input row variant: the 3px ink border box is a flex with the text input on the left and, pinned right, a 32px square acid chip (2px ink border) centering a hand-drawn-style check SVG (stroke #0a0a0a, stroke-width 3.5, stroke-linecap square, stroke-linejoin miter) to signal a valid state without color-only meaning.

### Error field with prefix + warning line
A prefixed input in an error state: a flex 3px ink border box with a 6px hard shadow where a paper-filled Space Mono prefix segment ('formcast.dev/') is separated from the input by a 3px ink right border. Beneath it, a bold ink (not muted) error line carrying a filled warning-triangle SVG and copy 'No spaces. Try' followed by an acid-highlighted Space-Mono suggestion chip ('my-space'). Error is communicated by shape + bold weight, not just hue.

### Three-way segmented control
A 3-column grid inside one 3px ink border box with shadow-hard, where each segment is divided by a 3px ink border. The active segment is acid-filled with Archivo font-800 uppercase ink text; inactive segments are white with font-700 ink/70 text and a hover:bg-paper. Used here for a Free / Pro / Team plan picker.

### Acid checkbox
A 24px square acid-filled box with a 3px ink border and shadow-hardsm, centering a hand-drawn-style check SVG (stroke #0a0a0a, stroke-width 3.5, square caps, miter joins), used inline at the start of a flex items-start label row with a 14px ink/80 consent label. The whole label is a cursor-pointer.

### Chunky brutalist button (.btn-press)
A solid rectangle with a 3px ink border and a hard offset shadow (shadow-hard 6px 6px 0 0 ink). Label in Archivo uppercase tracking-wide (font-800 to font-900). On hover it translates translate(-2px,-2px) and the shadow grows to 8px 8px 0 0 ink; on :active it presses to translate(3px,3px) with a 1px 1px shadow (transition ~0.08s). Variants by fill: acid (primary), ink with paper text (dark CTA), paper (secondary); the dark Studio card variant uses an acid-colored hard shadow 6px 6px 0 0 #e8ff00.

### Hard-shadow icon tile
A square place-items-center tile (sizes 36px nav / 48px patterns) with a 3px ink border, an acid fill (or paper on acid backgrounds), and shadow-hardsm, centering an Iconify Phosphor bold icon (ph:square-half-bold brand, ph:textbox-bold, ph:seal-check-bold, ph:keyboard-bold, ph:code-bold, ph:swatches-bold, ph:arrow-up-right-bold, etc.).

### Infinite marquee ticker (.ticker-track)
An overflow-hidden ink band holding a w-max flex track that animates scroll-x 28s linear infinite (transform translateX(0) to translateX(-50%)); the phrase set is duplicated (second copy aria-hidden) for a seamless loop. Phrases are acid Archivo font-800 uppercase tracking-widest separated by paper/40 '/' marks.

## Notas Especiais
Built on the Tailwind CDN with tailwind.config custom named colors paper #f4f1ea, ink #0a0a0a, acid #e8ff00, custom fontFamily display=Archivo / grotesk='Space Grotesk' / mono='Space Mono', and named boxShadow hard=6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a, hardlg=10px 10px 0 0 #0a0a0a, hardsm=4px 4px 0 0 #0a0a0a. Fonts load from Google Fonts (Archivo 400-900, Space Grotesk 400-700, Space Mono 400/700); icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:*) via the iconify-icon CDN; inline SVGs are used for the check and warning marks so state is shape-based not color-only. The 44px background grid is a CSS .grid-bg utility (two rgba(10,10,10,0.07) 1px linear-gradients). All micro-interactions (.btn-press, .field-focus, .lift, the ticker) are CSS transitions/keyframes, so on a single static frame the hover-lift, focus-lift and ticker scroll only fully animate live; the form is shown with illustrative values ('ekmas', 'hey@formcast.dev', a pre-acid 'Free' segment, an error 'my space' slug, a pre-checked checkbox) to demonstrate the field-state range. 'FORMCAST' is an illustrative product/brand placeholder for a generic brutalist form-builder landing.

special_ui_components.prompt: A prefixed input in an error state: a flex 3px ink border box with a 6px hard shadow where a paper-filled Space Mono prefix segment ('formcast.dev/') is separated from the input by a 3px ink right border. Beneath it, a bold ink (not muted) error line carrying a filled warning-triangle SVG and copy 'No spaces. Try' followed by an acid-highlighted Space-Mono suggestion chip ('my-space'). Error is communicated by shape + bold weight, not just hue.

A 3-column grid inside one 3px ink border box with shadow-hard, where each segment is divided by a 3px ink border. The active segment is acid-filled with Archivo font-800 uppercase ink text; inactive segments are white with font-700 ink/70 text and a hover:bg-paper. Used here for a Free / Pro / Team plan picker.

A 24px square acid-filled box with a 3px ink border and shadow-hardsm, centering a hand-drawn-style check SVG (stroke #0a0a0a, stroke-width 3.5, square caps, miter joins), used inline at the start of a flex items-start label row with a 14px ink/80 consent label. The whole label is a cursor-pointer.

A solid rectangle with a 3px ink border and a hard offset shadow (shadow-hard 6px 6px 0 0 ink). Label in Archivo uppercase tracking-wide (font-800 to font-900). On hover it translates translate(-2px,-2px) and the shadow grows to 8px 8px 0 0 ink; on :active it presses to translate(3px,3px) with a 1px 1px shadow (transition ~0.08s). Variants by fill: acid (primary), ink with paper text (dark CTA), paper (secondary); the dark Studio card variant uses an acid-colored hard shadow 6px 6px 0 0 #e8ff00.

A square place-items-center tile (sizes 36px nav / 48px patterns) with a 3px ink border, an acid fill (or paper on acid backgrounds), and shadow-hardsm, centering an Iconify Phosphor bold icon (ph:square-half-bold brand, ph:textbox-bold, ph:seal-check-bold, ph:keyboard-bold, ph:code-bold, ph:swatches-bold, ph:arrow-up-right-bold, etc.).

An overflow-hidden ink band holding a w-max flex track that animates scroll-x 28s linear infinite (transform translateX(0) to translateX(-50%)); the phrase set is duplicated (second copy aria-hidden) for a seamless loop. Phrases are acid Archivo font-800 uppercase tracking-widest separated by paper/40 '/' marks.

structured.special_notes: Built on the Tailwind CDN with tailwind.config custom named colors paper #f4f1ea, ink #0a0a0a, acid #e8ff00, custom fontFamily display=Archivo / grotesk='Space Grotesk' / mono='Space Mono', and named boxShadow hard=6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a, hardlg=10px 10px 0 0 #0a0a0a, hardsm=4px 4px 0 0 #0a0a0a. Fonts load from Google Fonts (Archivo 400-900, Space Grotesk 400-700, Space Mono 400/700); icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:*) via the iconify-icon CDN; inline SVGs are used for the check and warning marks so state is shape-based not color-only. The 44px background grid is a CSS .grid-bg utility (two rgba(10,10,10,0.07) 1px linear-gradients). All micro-interactions (.btn-press, .field-focus, .lift, the ticker) are CSS transitions/keyframes, so on a single static frame the hover-lift, focus-lift and ticker scroll only fully animate live; the form is shown with illustrative values ('ekmas', 'hey@formcast.dev', a pre-acid 'Free' segment, an error 'my space' slug, a pre-checked checkbox) to demonstrate the field-state range. 'FORMCAST' is an illustrative product/brand placeholder for a generic brutalist form-builder landing.
